crossRefs.note: Others fell into the good ground, and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty…
What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word, and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit…
Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly…
Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you…
I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do…
Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to…
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing…
Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and…
For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus…
Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. Yahweh blessed him.

parallels.note: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word, and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit…

translations.web: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, and accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”
translations.bsb: Still others are like the seeds sown on good soil. They hear the word, receive it, and produce a crop—thirtyfold, sixtyfold, or a hundredfold.”
translations.kjv: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
translations.asv: And those are they that were sown upon the good ground; such as hear the word, and accept it, and bear fruit, thirtyfold, and sixtyfold, and a hundredfold.
